subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should yield capability use a dedicated pre-execution Plugin SDK marker, or should `executionMode: "sequential"` permanently mean that a tool can never enter Tool Search, Code Mode, or headless catalogs?
rationale: This choice defines a new external Plugin SDK contract and changes existing catalog semantics; code inspection can identify the compatibility impact but cannot choose the permanent API meaning without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a dedicated yield capability
options.body: Introduce an explicit tool-definition marker for yield-capable/direct tools and preserve catalog eligibility for unrelated sequential tools.

options.title: Redefine sequential globally
options.body: Document and accept that every sequential tool is always model-visible and unavailable through headless catalogs.

options.title: Pause the public API
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and rework the PR after a more general catalog bridge can preserve target scheduling and result controls.

recommendation.title: Add a dedicated yield capability
recommendation.body: Introduce an explicit tool-definition marker for yield-capable/direct tools and preserve catalog eligibility for unrelated sequential tools.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the existing yield lifecycle and previously guided its owner-boundary and turn-ending design.
